proxy.scope: When supported, the proxy covers in-app web requests and authorized downloads. Check each result after saving. The update service is excluded. Testing checks one download request and does not verify player traffic.
proxy.unsupported: Settings saved, but this device cannot apply the web proxy.
proxy.partial: Settings saved and applied to web requests. The proxy has not been applied to authorized downloads.
proxy.applied: Proxy applied to in-app web requests and authorized downloads.
proxy.restart: Settings saved. The web proxy will take effect on the next launch.
proxy.downloads_unapplied: Authorized download proxy: not applied yet.
proxy.invalid: Choose HTTP or HTTPS, enter a hostname or IP address and an integer port from 1 to 65535. Credentials are not supported.
proxy.load_failed: Could not read the saved proxy settings.
proxy.save_failed: Could not save and apply the proxy. Please try again.
